# tai42
> tai42 takes AI from demo to production: business functions that run themselves as production applications, humans at the named decisions. Platform: BabelFish (deterministic flow engine, visual builder, governance, optimizer). Open-source runtime.
## Pages
- Home: https://tai42.ai/
- Method: https://tai42.ai/method
- Platform (BabelFish): https://tai42.ai/platform
- Open source: https://tai42.ai/open-source
- About: https://tai42.ai/about
- Builders (founding waitlist): https://tai42.ai/builders
- Docs: https://docs.tai42.ai
